description_expanded: Nestled within the peaceful charm of The Preserve at Grayton Beach, Salty Seahorse Cottage is a spacious three-bedroom, two-bath retreat designed for relaxed coastal living. Comfortably accommodating up to 11 guests with additional bunk space and a Queen sleeper sofa, this inviting single-level home is a scenic 7–10 minute walk to the community’s private beach access, where a picturesque boardwalk winds through trees and native greenery before opening to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. With two delightful porches and a quiet neighborhood setting, it’s easy to see why guests return year after year. Inside, the home feels bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully appointed. The open living area features comfortable seating and a Queen sleeper sofa, with direct patio access that extends the gathering space outdoors. The kitchen is both beautiful and functional, offering granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, rich wood cabinetry, an extra-large French-door refrigerator, and two breakfast bars—ideal for everything from pancake breakfasts to evening appetizers. The adjacent dining area invites lingering meals and easy conversation. Two Queen bedrooms provide restful retreats, including one with a beautifully tiled walk-in shower in its ensuite bath. A hall bath with a tub/shower combination serves guests and the charming bunk room with a Twin bunk bed & a Full bunk bed, making the layout especially accommodating for families. A full laundry room, central air, ceiling fans throughout, and complimentary high-speed WiFi add everyday ease to your stay. Beyond the cottage, guests enjoy access to The Preserve’s two seasonally heated community pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and private beach access—making it simple to fill each day with as much activity or relaxation as you choose. Scenic 30A is just moments away, placing you within easy biking distance of Gulf Place, Blue Mountain Beach, Seaside, WaterColor, Seagrove, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach—each offering its own blend of dining, shopping, and coastal charm. Whether teenagers are exploring on bikes, families are strolling to dinner, or everyone is soaking up the sun by the pool, the location strikes a perfect balance of convenience and tranquility. Clean, comfortable, and ideally situated, Salty Seahorse Cottage offers the kind of easygoing coastal experience that keeps guests planning their next stay before the first one even ends. First Floor: Living Room with Twin Sleeper Sofa and Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Bunk with a Full/Full & Twin/Twin Bunk, Laundry. Based on the daily temperature and at the HOA's discretion, the western community pool is typically heated during holiday weeks and spring break. Preserve at Grayton Beach utilizes ample shore to the East of Little Redfish Lake and West of Big Redfish Lake. The beach portion in front of Bannerman Beach and Sanctuary By The Sea is strictly prohibited. Boats, golf carts, storage trailers, and recreational vehicles are not permitted.
